input.content:
# Welcome Book topic coverage gaps

Audit of `book.py` `TOPICS` against `cases.json`. Only counts **behavioral** cases (a query that exercises the topic). Structural journey-enumerator cases (`resume_skips_ticked_checklist`, `tools_status_lists_all`, `section_header_not_empty`) list every checklist id and are excluded — they assert journey shape, not that the agent can answer about the topic.

## No behavioral coverage

| Topic | Section | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| `collaboration_rules` | Working at Concept | Prescriptive rules (dress code, remote-work norms) — highest-risk topic to confabulate; no test catches a wrong rule. |
| `events` | Working at Concept | Answer depends on live/current schedule; without a case, we don't know if the agent invents recurring events or defers correctly. |
| `bench_time` | Working at Concept | Sensitive HR concept (unbilled hours). Wrong policy phrasing has legal/manager-perception cost; currently untested. |
| `hr_contacts` | Working at Concept | People-lookup topic — the exact failure mode the KB-stale-facts problem is about. No case guards against a hallucinated HR contact. |
| `sharepoint` | Tools & Apps | Has a `keyvalue` card in `_TOPIC_CARDS`; the deterministic card-staging path for this variant is not exercised end-to-end. |
| `teams` (MS Teams) | Tools & Apps | Same as sharepoint — `keyvalue` card staging untested for this topic. Also the most-used daily tool, so a wrong access answer is high-blast-radius. |
| `gitlab` | Tools & Apps | Access instructions vary by BU/office; card-less topic relies on retrieval — no case verifies the agent doesn't invent a URL or SSO step. |
| `servus_concept` | Tools & Apps | Internal portal name easily confused with generic greetings; untested → risk the agent treats "servus" as small talk instead of the tool. |
| `tool_access` | Tools & Apps | Catch-all "how do I request access to X" path. No case checks the agent routes to the right owner instead of guessing. |
